summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for the package, aggregating foundational utilities, type definitions, and core domain schemas that facilitate standardized data modeling, type-safe configuration, and system-wide structural operations.
responsibilities: Export public APIs for core domain functionality
Define standardized object normalization and configuration tools
Expose core schemas and type definitions for system-wide consumption
relationships: Public type utilities operate on core domain entities to provide flexible data handling.
Configuration helpers integrate with schema definitions to ensure type-safe project modeling.
The central export layer reconciles internal module structures into a cohesive interface for external consumers.
designDecisions: Use of barrel files for centralized API exposure
Implementation of recursive type transformations for object flexibility
Nominal branding for type safety in system path representations
Decoupling of structural utility logic from domain-specific implementations
